name: [🐫New Heist!] Riot City 🚨 Prison Escape
desc:
Welcome to Riot City! Escape prison, become a criminal, rob the bank, collect cars and guns, or enforce the law as a cop and arrest criminals!

🚨 November 6th Update:
📢 New Pyramid Robbery!
🔫 M134 Minigun!
🚗 Bevor B64 6x6!
🐛 Bug fixes

👮‍♂️ Riot City is the ultimate cops vs prisoners experience on Roblox. Jump into a massive open-world city where every session is a battle between chaos and justice. Start as a prisoner, break out, build your criminal empire, pull off robberies, escape high-speed police chases, and dominate the streets. Or join the police force, gear up, hunt down dangerous criminals, shut down heists, and restore order across the city. With 20+ vehicles and 15+ guns to collect, Riot City is packed with action, progression, and deep customization. Build your perfect ride with vehicle upgrades and customization options, expand your arsenal, and battle on either side of the law

🌟 Premium: +10% money! 🌟
🌟 Riot City Studio group members: +10% money! 🌟

llm.loop: escape prison as a criminal or join the police -> rob heists / arrest criminals for cash -> buy cars, guns and upgrades -> take on bigger heists
llm.objectives: pull off robberies and escape cops, or arrest criminals; collect 20+ vehicles and 15+ guns
llm.progression: cash from heists and arrests, vehicle and weapon collection, vehicle customization
llm.instructions: escape prison, become a criminal and rob the bank, or enforce the law as a cop
unique: frequent new named heists (Pyramid Robbery) as the update cadence
update_signals: November 6 update with new robbery, gun and vehicle
llm.thumbnails: stylised art of prisoners in orange jumpsuits fleeing in a gold 6x6, on a motorbike chased by police, and in a supercar from the bank; Riot City logo
llm.complexity_notes: large open-world city, many drivable vehicles, guns, team roles, multiple heist locations
